verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say submitters can receive review comments and "respond or modify code online," and reviewers can browse code and leave feedback in the browser. That directly addresses the core of the story, but it is a single brief vendor claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a web editor that creates commits on the PR branch, details of the in-browser edit and commit flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can respond to review feedback by editing and committing code directly in the browser

citations.quote: Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.
